5927.title: Automation CLI rejects unresolved execution options
5927.rootCauseOneLine: The agent creation handler rejects omitted provider/model options before consulting calling-thread or remembered execution defaults.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff targets the observed rejection path with SDK default resolution; the PR branch was not executed.

5927.proposedFix: Resolve missing creation-time execution options through existing SDK defaults while preserving explicit overrides, provider/model pairing, permissions, routing, and update behavior.
5927.caveats: Complete regression test and path-free output are embedded in HTML. No external CLI subprocess, conversation rendering, or live provider model catalog was exercised. No duplicate fix: open PR #5928 already closes the issue.
